summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature. rich/progress.py: module-level open and wrap_file (beside track()), Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods (beside track()), and private _ProgressReader plus _reader_context helper (before class Progress). tests/test_progress.py: 17 new tests before the script-entry block. docs/source/progress.rst: "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections. CHANGELOG.md: one Added bullet linking PR 1759. Nothing committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run (instructed not to run code), so verification was by reading only. Known risks: the module-level open passes a plain str mode to the overloaded Progress.open, which mypy will likely flag at that call site; the wrap_file total annotation is int while stored task totals are floats.
